aggregation_policies.derived_ratios: computed only from complete, matched inputs with positive denominator; session ratios are never averaged
aggregation_policies.average_movement_intensity: session values preserved; no daily aggregate produced
aggregation_policies.source_reported_fields: ACWR/ATL/CTL preserved as source-reported, not recalculated
aggregation_policies.duplicates: exact copies excluded from totals (one canonical kept); possible overlaps kept included until reviewed

athlete_id.description: Deterministic LoadWise athlete identifier (stable across uploads).

athlete_label.description: Original athlete display label from the source, whitespace-trimmed.

date_resolved.description: Day/month source date resolved to a full date using the configured season start year. null when the date is missing/unresolvable.

date_raw.description: Verbatim source date value (preserved, never mutated).

day_index.description: Sequential study-day index from the source 'Day' column. NOT a weekday.

duration_min.description: Session/day duration in minutes. Excel day-fractions are x1440; 'hh:mm:ss' durations are parsed. Full precision kept internally.

high_intensity_min.description: High-intensity training time in minutes (from the 'High intensity training' duration column).

trimp.description: Training Impulse, a dimensionless index. Additive across sessions.

movement_load.description: Movement Load in source-defined arbitrary units. Additive across sessions.

avg_movement_intensity_source.description: Average Movement Intensity exactly as reported by the source. LoadWise makes NO claim that this equals Movement Load / duration, and does not produce a daily aggregate for it.

trimp_per_min_source.description: Source-reported TRIMP/min. Preserved separately from the LoadWise-calculated daily TRIMP-per-minute.

efficiency_calculated.unit: ratio (movement load units per TRIMP index)
efficiency_calculated.description: LoadWise daily Efficiency = total Movement Load / total TRIMP. Computed only when both inputs are complete over the same included sessions and TRIMP > 0; otherwise null with a reason.

trimp_per_min_calculated.description: LoadWise daily TRIMP/min = total TRIMP / total duration (minutes). Computed only when both inputs are complete and duration > 0.

source_acwr.description: ACWR exactly as reported by the source system. NOT independently calculated by LoadWise. A separate ACWR module (window + missing-day policy still to be agreed) will compute an independent value later.

measurement_error_pct.description: Measurement error. Stored in the source as a fraction (format '0.00 %'); converted to percentage points here.

completeness.description: Per-metric completeness: 'complete' (all included sessions contributed), 'partial' (some contributed), or 'missing' (none did -> value is null).

wellness_scores.description: Same-day wellness observations. Scale, direction and units are NOT assumed -- in particular 'sleep_time' is NOT assumed to be hours.

gd.description: Source Game-Day context label (e.g. GD, GD-1, GD+1). Observed context, not a complete forward schedule.
